scope: prospective method for three-repeat focused history32 comparison, not final qualification
regression_method: candidate against reference extrema plus max(two reference spreads, declared floor); every repeat and both directions; alternating control/candidate order and contemporary two-leg UDP baseline
additional_small_packet_gate: candidate may deliver at most two messages fewer than its adjacent control per direction
absolute_criteria: unchanged SC003 >=80% capacity delivery; SC004 <=0.1pp added subcapacity loss; SC005 <=5ms added subcapacity RTT; SC007 resource >=500 Mbit/s per direction, <=2 cores and <=128 MiB per role
validity: generator/clock/diagnostic checks, >=100 RTT samples/session in each comparative row; reference validity preserved explicitly
on_failure: stop candidate comparison at first failed pair; retain all completed/failed evidence; no changed thresholds
